title: Coordinated pausing: An evaluation-based coordination scheme for frontier AI developers
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct benchmarks related to faith or religion. It proposes a coordination scheme for pausing AI development based on evaluations for general 'dangerous capabilities' such as autonomous replication, power-seeking, and developing biological weapons.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith. Its focus is on AI safety governance, proposing a multi-step coordination scheme for frontier AI developers to pause development when a model exhibits dangerous capabilities.
